scripts.build: node scripts/build-info.cjs && node scripts/prepare-cloudflare-assets.cjs && vite build

scripts.normalize:emeritus: mkdir -p scripts/.build && esbuild scripts/normalize_emeritus.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=scripts/.build/normalize_emeritus.cjs --log-level=warning && node scripts/.build/normalize_emeritus.cjs
scripts.export:abes: mkdir -p scripts/.build && esbuild scripts/export_abes.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:xlsx --outfile=scripts/.build/export_abes.cjs --log-level=warning && node scripts/.build/export_abes.cjs
